item.title: Alford’s red-zone pick saves Falcons’ 19-17 win over Saints, giving NFC South title to Panthers
item.description: Dee Alford's red-zone interception stopped a potential go-ahead drive by New Orleans, and the Atlanta Falcons beat the Saints 19-17 on Sunday to give the NFC South title to the Carolina Panthers.

item.title: Rubio suggests US won’t run Venezuela day-to-day
item.description: Rubio’s statements seemed designed to temper concerns about whether the assertive American action to achieve regime change might again produce a prolonged foreign intervention or failed attempt at nation-building.

item.title: North Korea launches ballistic missiles toward sea ahead of South Korean leader’s visit to China
item.description: South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff said in a statement it detected several ballistic missile launches from North Korea's capital region around 7:50 a.m. It said the missiles flew about 900 kilometers (560 miles) and that South Korea and U.S. authorities were analyzing details of the launches.

item.title: Gunmen kill at least 30 villagers and abduct others during raid in northern Nigeria
item.description: At least 30 villagers have been killed and several others are missing after gunmen raided a village in northern Nigeria’s Niger state, police said Sunday, the latest in a cycle of deadly violence in the conflict-hit region.

item.title: ‘Still shaken’: Trepidation in Venezuela after US captures Maduro
item.description: An anxious quiet fell over Venezuela 's capital on Sunday as trepidation mixed with joy while a nation waited to see what comes next.

item.title: Local Venezuelan reacts to the US’ attack and capture of President Maduro
item.description: After the U.S. Military operations that happened in Venezuela, a local Venezuelan man reacts to what happened in his home country, and gives his thoughts.

item.title: Wilmington community hold meeting to address issue of water possibly being taken out of the Cape Fear River
item.description: After no public hearings near the cape fear region, Wilmington community members unite to address and inform the community about water possibly being taken out of the Cape Fear River

item.title: Multiple organizations join hands to help clean a local park
item.description: To kick off the new year in a fresh start, multiple local organizations came together to help clean out a local park and plant some trees.

item.title: Dozens of people gather in Castle Hayne to try their hand at lawn mower racing
item.description: Prosperity Motorplex hosted a lawn mower mud racing event that had obstacle courses, mud drag racing, and lawn mower races.
